title: Write the contract URN as contract:{artifact_name}, copied verbatim

facts.note: Task, plan or review text mentions contract URNs or artifact references.

values: contract:* token present in any repository text (new, edited or pre-existing)
facts.note: Detector that extracts every contract:* token anywhere it is authored or checked (plans, wagons, WMBTs, acceptances, docs, schemas, code, config) and compares it with the referenced artifact name; covers validation of existing URNs, not only diffs.
Diff-level view of the same detector; one trigger among several, not a gate.

fires: Any document or file (e.g. a wagon, acceptance, plan doc, schema or config) writes the contract URN for the artifact commons:identifiers.uuid.
A plan doc lists produced/consumed artifacts with their contract URNs.
An artifact is renamed and the contract URNs that point at it must be updated.
A review or validation pass checks existing contract URNs that were not edited in the current change.
doesNotFire: Text names an artifact without writing or checking any contract URN.
Deciding the artifact name itself (governed by planner.artifact-naming.naming-pattern).

given: A contract URN for an artifact appears anywhere it is authored or checked (e.g. a plan, wagon, WMBT, acceptance or doc), whether new or already existing
when: that contract URN is written, edited, or validated
then: The URN is exactly contract:{artifact_name}, with the artifact name copied verbatim, preserving every colon and dot.
prefer: Copy the artifact name as-is after the contract: prefix, e.g. commons:identifiers.uuid -> contract:commons:identifiers.uuid.
Keep multi-segment names intact, e.g. commons:ux:foundations:color.primary -> contract:commons:ux:foundations:color.primary.
avoid: Normalising separators (turning colons into dots/slashes or dots into colons) inside the URN.
Shortening, re-casing, dropping or adding segments so the URN no longer equals the artifact name.
Inventing a URN form other than contract:{artifact_name}.
why: The contract URN is the URN form of the artifact name; an exact mirror keeps one artifact identity that references and the schema $id can share without translation.
evidence: For every contract:* URN found (new or pre-existing, in any location), stripping the contract: prefix yields a string identical to the referenced artifact name (the artifact need not already exist; planned artifacts count).
Source examples hold: commons:identifiers.uuid -> contract:commons:identifiers.uuid; commons:ux:foundations:color.primary -> contract:commons:ux:foundations:color.primary.
verifier_detail: Term contract_urn: the URN form of an artifact name; pattern contract:{artifact_name}.

Comparison is exact string equality between the text after the literal prefix 'contract:' and the referenced artifact name; colons and dots are significant and must not be normalised. Do not require the artifact to exist already.
Scan scope is not limited to planning documents or to changed lines: validate all contract URNs wherever they occur.
